answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using proof of space-time. Agents commit non-volatile storage by plotting unique tables, resolving audit challenges sent over whisper gossip channels. This forces attackers to dedicate scarce physical disk capacity per identity rather than deploying a nebula of virtual clones. Verified proofs anchor to an immutable marble ledger. However, continuous auditing accelerates drive degradation and favors centralized actors with bulk storage.
